items.title: Kyiv district official discusses temporary pit toilets amid infrastructure disruptions
items.summary: Desnianskyi district administrator Maksym Bakhmatov discussed using temporary pit-style toilets as continued strikes threaten Kyiv's sanitation infrastructure. He said facilities could be installed in enclosed structures and referred to the needs of roughly 300,000 residents in the district.

items.title: Kryvyi Rih water pressure falls after reported missile strikes disable pumping station
items.summary: A local water utility reportedly said missile strikes stopped a pumping station in Kryvyi Rih, leaving three city districts with reduced water pressure or temporary supply outages. The disruption follows earlier reports of missile impacts and fires in the city.

items.title: Sevastopol governor outlines alternative passenger routes after Crimean Bridge attack
items.summary: Governor Mikhail Razvozhaev said reserve supply routes are keeping food, medicine and fuel deliveries to Sevastopol operating despite the attack on the Crimean Bridge. He said passenger travel is the main challenge, with bus-to-rail transfers being arranged in Kerch and possible sea services under consideration.
